title: A matrix through pointers
description:
Store a matrix in one flat array and work on it through pointers.

```
A =      B =      A x B =
1 2      5 6      19 22
3 4      7 8      43 50
transpose(A) = 1 3 / 2 4
```
hints: Three nested loops: `out[r * p + c] = sum over k of a[r * m + k] * b[k * p + c]` (lesson 3.04).
`printf("%g ", m[r * cols + c])` prints numbers without unneeded zeros.
requirements: `void mat_print(const double *m, int rows, int cols)`.
`void mat_mul(const double *a, const double *b, double *out, int n, int m, int p)` for an n×m times m×p matrix.
Element `(r, c)` of a matrix with `cols` columns is at `m[r * cols + c]`.
Use `const` on everything that is only read.
stretch: Write `int mat_identity(const double *m, int n)` and check that A times the identity is A.
